question: who was announced on 26 June 2025 as first Indian astronaut for Titans Space mission ?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Jahnavi Danget**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jahnavi Danget** was announced as the **first Indian astronaut** selected for the prestigious **Titans Space Mission** on **26 June 2025.**
 
• This announcement marks a **historic milestone** for India in the field of **space exploration**.
 
• Jahnavi Danget is recognized for her **outstanding contributions** in the field of **aerospace engineering** and her **dedication** to advancing India's space capabilities.
 
• The **Titans Space Mission** is an international collaboration aimed at exploring **Saturn's largest moon, Titan**, which has intrigued scientists due to its **earth-like atmosphere** and potential for harboring life.
 
• This mission will significantly strengthen India's position as a key player in **global space research** and inspire the younger generation to pursue careers in **STEM fields**.
 
• Her selection also highlights the **increasing participation** of **women** in the field of space exploration, breaking barriers and setting new benchmarks.
 
• The mission is expected to contribute to the understanding of **planetary systems, astrobiology, and the potential for life beyond Earth.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rakesh Sharma**__

 __
 
• **Rakesh Sharma** was the **first Indian astronaut** to travel to space in **1984** aboard the Soviet spacecraft **Soyuz T-11.**
 
• He was part of the **Intercosmos Program** and conducted experiments aboard the **Salyut 7 space station.**
 
• His famous statement "Saare Jahan Se Achha" when asked about India from space remains a symbol of national pride.
 
 
 
• **Sunita Williams**__
 __
 
• **Sunita Williams** is an **Indian-American astronaut** who has participated in multiple missions aboard the **International Space Station (ISS).**
 
• She holds the record for the **most spacewalks by a woman astronaut** and is renowned for her achievements in **NASA's space programs.**
 
• Although of Indian origin, she is a **citizen of the United States** and not the first Indian astronaut.
 
 
 
• **Minal Patel**__
 
 
• There is **no documented evidence** of Minal Patel being associated with any space mission or astronaut program.
 
• It is likely that this option is included to test general knowledge and awareness of prominent figures in space exploration.
